ordered_diagnoses: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma

s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: weight loss without fever or sweats
key_facts: male patient in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
normal chest radiograph and high-resolution chest CT scan
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples
atypical lymphocytes with CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

shortlist: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate and atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples

shortlist.label: Mycois fungoides
shortlist.why_kept: presentation of pink-purple dermal papules on extensor surfaces, and immunostaining showed lymphocytes positive for CD3 and inverted CD8:CD4 ratio

shortlist.label: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy findings and immunophenotype of atypical lymphocytes with CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

shortlist.label: Sézary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: systemic symptoms such as fatigue, dyspnea on exertion, and weight loss, and presence of atypical lymphocytes in the blood and skin

shortlist.label: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of atypical lymphocytes with CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype, and systemic symptoms

s4.champion: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma

raw.champion: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with pink-purple dermal papules, preference for extensor surfaces, and atypical lymphocytes with a CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype, along with clonal rearrangements in skin and bone marrow, is most consistent with Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses several subtypes, including the champion diagnosis

rejected.label: Mycois fungoides
rejected.why: Typically presents with CD4-positive lymphocytes, not CD8-positive as seen in this patient

rejected.label: Sézary syndrome
rejected.why: Characterized by erythroderma, lymphadenopathy, and atypical lymphocytes in the blood, which are not present in this case

rejected.label: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
rejected.why: Typically associated with HTLV-1 infection and has distinct clinical and laboratory features not seen in this patient
